type: Video Browsing; caption: Zhuge Jin made Liu Bei so angry he coughed up blood #FastTalkDramaReview #NewThreeKingdoms #FastGrowthPlan #FilmAndTVFutureStars; ocr: The entrustment at White Emperor City. Soon after, Zhuge Liang and others finally arrived at White Emperor City. Adou, with an IQ as high as 250, was immediately at a loss. But this sense of being moved seemed to have an expiration date.; asr: Are you here to humiliate me? This is the highest realm of killing someone and destroying their spirit. Zhuge Liang used only three sentences to nearly make Liu Bei, who had just experienced the devastating defeat at Yiling, retire on the spot. It turned out that to cope with the hot and dry summer weather, Liu Bei had ordered his army to set up camps continuously for 700 li through the mountain forests - little did he know this violated a cardinal military taboo. Lu Xun used just one fire to turn the 700 li of continuous camps into 700 li of fire basins. Overnight, 700,000 Shu troops were reduced to ashes. Finally, after going through countless hardships, Liu Bei escaped to Baidi City. Knowing his days were numbered, he hastily ordered Zhao Yun to bring Zhuge Liang and others to entrust them with his final wishes. At this time, in Chengdu, the dutiful son Liu Chan had already cried himself into a tearful mess. Zhuge Liang comforted him to rest early, as they still had to travel to Baidi City tomorrow, then turned to leave. "Minister, can I bring some personal items?" "The palace will prepare everything properly for Your Highness, no need to worry." "What about Juju?" "What? These two people, Juju, are inseparable from me for even a moment." Even the supremely intelligent Zhuge Liang's brain froze for half a minute, but he quickly recovered and said that if His Highness brought these two Juju, wouldn't it cause His Majesty to be shocked on his deathbed and slap you so hard you'd spin around from the power of love? "Oh, I guess I won't bring them then." Hearing this, Zhuge Liang let out a long sigh, thinking this truly was the hopeless Adou. Many people say Adou's foolishness is an act, but pretending to be foolish day after day for ten years - what's the difference between that and being truly foolish?

Before long, Zhuge Liang and the others finally arrived at Baidi City. Liu Bei had already been lying in his sickbed for several days. During these days, he had been filled with painful regret over the strategic mistakes he had made. Looking at Zhuge Liang, who was already in tears before him, Liu Bei was even more remorseful, saying that he had once visited the thatched cottage three times to invite him out, promising to heed his advice on everything. But after establishing the Great Han and becoming emperor, he could no longer listen to anyone's counsel. If not for this, how could he have suffered the defeat at Yiling? At this moment, Zhuge Liang felt that the obedient Liu Bei of old had returned, but unfortunately it was too late. Now the Shu Han's resources had been completely depleted by Liu Bei. To restore national strength would probably take ten years, and whether Liu Bei could live until then was uncertain. At this time, Ma Liang rushed in to report that dozens of Wu army warships had suddenly appeared on the river, heading straight toward their forces.

Just as he was about to order the troops to prepare for battle, Zhuge Liang quickly helped Liu Bei lie down, saying he would handle the enemy situation himself. Zhuge Liang then ordered Zhao Yun to close all city gates and defend the position against the Wu army's attack. Unexpectedly, Ma Su soon brought the latest news - the Wu army's purpose this time was not to attack the city, but to send Zhuge Jin for friendly talks. Thus Liu Bei dragged his weak body to the hall, but Zhuge Jin's next words completely broke his defenses: "I am ordered by the King of Wu to return over 20,000 captured Shu soldiers, along with weapons, carts, boats, and warhorses. Eastern Wu's victory was purely by chance. The King of Wu apologizes to Your Majesty."

It turned out Zhuge Jin's purpose in coming was to hope that Sun and Liu would continue their alliance to jointly resist the usurping Cao Wei. Hearing this, Liu Bei tremblingly stood up. He thought of how not long ago, when he was attacking Eastern Wu and winning consecutive victories, Zhuge Jin had also come to sue for peace once. At that time, he was terrified and didn't even dare to look up, but now his attitude was so arrogant and proud. Liu Bei immediately felt deeply humiliated, pointed at Zhuge Jin and spat out 800cc of tomato sauce. "Ah! Are you here to humiliate me?" "Your Majesty, please calm down. You should withdraw first and we'll discuss this later."

If you don't dare, then get out of here and die. This was the second time Tiger Fool Xu Chu had encountered such a strange request. Looking at the corpse that had already gone cold on the ground, he couldn't help but recall an old acquaintance from ten years ago. That person was also extremely arrogant and audacious, actually stretching out his neck and demanding to be beheaded. "You just want Xu You's head, don't you? Come, today this man surnamed Xu will stretch his neck out to you. If you have the guts, strike it off." To fulfill Xu You's wish, Xu Chu immediately took the large blade handed to him by a soldier, then with one swift motion sent him to meet the King of Hell. From then on, the name of Tiger Fool Xu Chu resounded throughout the land. After dealing with the person before him, Xu Chu ordered a prohibition. He had come this time under orders from the current King of Wei, Cao Pi, to capture Cao Zhi and bring him back to Xuchang for punishment. At this moment, Cao Zhi was still drinking merrily with his friends, composing poetry. Even though he was already quite drunk and swaying from side to side, he could still compose verses effortlessly, which drew continuous applause from his companions. However, with Xu Chu's arrival, the atmosphere instantly froze. The lively party from moments ago now had no one who dared make a sound. Seeing this, Cao Zhi pretended to be oblivious and approached Xu Chu with a cheerful joke: "You've also smelled the fragrance of wine from my residence? Then let me grant you a cup to taste." Xu Chu looked at the wine bowl presented before him with disgust and without courtesy raised his hand to knock it over. Cao Zhi didn't get angry at this, but instead bent down to pick up the wine bowl from the ground and drank the little that remained. However, after finishing, Cao Zhi suddenly challenged Xu Chu: "Xu Chu, I order you to pierce my heart with an arrow. Come quickly! I am the son of the Xian King. Either kill me or kneel before me. Why hesitate? Kneel and speak!" Xu Chu was completely bewildered by Cao Zhi's sudden action. If it were an ordinary person making this strange request, he would have fulfilled it without hesitation. But Cao Zhi had deliberately mentioned that he was the son of the Xian King, and it was precisely this statement that made the usually fierce Xu Chu calm down, because Cao Cao was the person Xu Chu respected most in his life, bar none. With no other choice, he could only sheathe his sword, then kneel on one knee before Cao Zhi in salute, requesting that he immediately accompany him to Xuchang. Seeing this, Cao Zhi stopped making things difficult and indicated he understood and would go with him at once. His friends all tried to dissuade him, saying not to go—anyone with eyes could see this trip would surely mean death. But Cao Zhi had long since become indifferent to life and death, saying that the poems he left behind would be remembered for eternity, and he had no regrets in this life, so why fear death? In this world, living one more day isn't long, living one day less isn't short—just live happily and let life and death take their course. After Cao Zhi finished this last cup of wine, Xu Chu urged him to set off quickly. But just as Cao Zhi had taken a few steps, his friends all knelt under the pavilion, once again trying to dissuade him from going. Hearing this, Cao Zhi turned around and looked at the pavilion before him, filled with emotion. For over ten years, Cao Zhi and his friends had often composed poetry under this pavilion. This pavilion held too many beautiful memories, and being immersed daily in the atmosphere of poetry had saturated it with sentiment. So Cao Zhi said that if he couldn't return, they should tear down this pavilion for him. With that, Cao Zhi left with loud laughter, while his friends all bowed in final farewell. Upon reaching Xuchang, all the officials had already gathered there, and Cao Pi, as King of Wei, sat in the center of the great hall. type: Video Browsing; caption: Saving Hundreds of Millions! How Do Filmmakers Create Night Scenes During Daytime? #filmmaking #shooting #filmindustry #filmstorm; ocr: Daytime scene material source. Behind the scenes of "Heir of the Night," involving 26 episodes of night scenes. Reference materials: production staff, Tian. For detailed information, please visit the "Yingshi Jufeng" TB store or store.com. Operations: Long Hui. Subtitles: San Tong. Equipment used in this episode.; asr: Hello, I'm Tem. Welcome to this episode. In movies, there are often many nighttime scenes, but as you may know, not all of them are actually shot at night. In fact, what we're doing right now wasn't filmed at night either. This effect is called "day for night," which means shooting night scenes during the day. There are actually many techniques worth discussing, so in this episode, we'll explore the various fascinating techniques of day-for-night shooting. You may have already encountered day-for-night without even realizing it - for example, in these familiar scenes. They were all completed during daytime. Truffaut even had a film specifically named after this shooting technique. You might wonder why some directors choose to shoot night scenes during the day - it doesn't make sense, right? The most obvious reason you can probably guess is money. The cost of lighting equipment for nighttime shooting is usually quite high. For example, in "First Man," the director custom-made a 200K light to illuminate the quarry - twice as bright as those super large lights electricians use - and suspended it on a crane over 90 meters high. The rental for just this one light was about $2,000 per day. Some films have even grander scenes, like the timeless classic "Titanic." To let audiences see such a brightly lit ship, Cameron set up more lights outside the ship than inside. In total, they used approximately 3,000 lights and 48 kilometers of cable. Rumor has it the minimum cost for lighting alone was $15 million. However, after seeing news that their total production budget exceeded from $80 million to $200 million, I think an even higher figure isn't impossible. Of course, directors don't choose day-for-night just because of lighting equipment costs, but also time costs. For instance, "Creatures of the Night," because the protagonist is a vampire who only appears at night, involved a full 26 episodes of night scenes. If these scenes were only shot at night, it would take about 13 months to complete, but the director's actual shooting schedule was 107 days. Day-for-night methods vary. Some directors choose to shoot in front of green or blue screens, then composite them into night scenes through CG. However, there are more economical methods - picking a day without strong sunlight to shoot directly, then in post-production, reducing saturation, adding blue filters, and so on to make the footage closer to nighttime texture. This is where the legendary secondary color grading comes in - making color and brightness corrections to specific parts of the frame. This is its definition, and this is when the colorist's role becomes crucial. However, this method isn't quite perfect. If you pay special attention while watching movies, you'll still find traces of day-for-night shooting. For example, overly bright skies - this is actually a thorny problem for many directors. In the classic Western "The Wild Bunch," although post-production processed the footage to look very close to nighttime, the sky in many shots still looks off. This is because daytime skies often have excessive brightness and light ratio, and color grading alone really can't make the sky look like a real night sky. If you see shots like this in a movie, it's most likely shot during the day. See those very clear shadows on the ground? type: Video Browsing; caption: The Fierce Confrontation Between Cao Pi and His Sister and the Farcical End of the Han Dynasty #FilmAndTVCommentary #RecommendedDrama; ocr: Tonight, watching the series. He wants the Emperor tonight. Does he really intend to abolish Han and establish himself? Sima Yi appears to deliver the final blow, posing no threat to himself. Built a platform for receiving the mandate outside the city, this edict must be issued by you. A living puppet manipulated by others.; asr: What can I do while you eat? What was done today, the mandarin ducks are higher than two feet - it was your father who made you empress. Do you know why Father did that back then? He wanted to make the Son of Heaven our Cao family's son-in-law. Cao Cao and his elder sister put on quite a spectacular performance, their acting completely crushing the old man. With Cao Cao's assistance, that wolf cub's ambitions were fully exposed, undoubtedly just two and a half minutes ago. Cao Yu even pushed his brother-in-law Liu Xie to the brink of collapse. But just as he walked out of the hall, he ran into his sister Cao Jie coming toward him. Seeing his sister kneel, Cao Pi quickly stepped forward. You are the Empress, never forgotten. Do you still acknowledge me as your sister? Of course we do. Siblings born of the same parents, for all lifetimes. Cao Jie, seeing he still had some respect for her, advised him in the manner of an elder: You've only inherited the throne for a few days and already want to rule the world. Aren't you afraid Father will curse you from heaven, or that the people will dig up your grave? I'm not afraid. Father's spirit in heaven will surely be happy for me if he sees this. What about the people of the world then? Haha. What's there to fear from the people? As long as I give them a good life with wife, children, and a warm bed, they'll still call me a sage ruler. His elder sister was so angry she cursed him as shameless. But this scolding made Cao Pi reveal his true voice: What can I do? What was done today, the moon is higher than two feet. He also warned her that she was a descendant of the Cao family with Cao blood flowing through her veins, that Father's arrangement back then was to make the Son of Heaven the Cao family's son-in-law, and if she betrayed the Cao family, their ancestors and father's spirits would truly curse her. Hearing this, the elder sister's heart felt like it was being cut by knives, but she still wanted to confirm once more whether he truly intended to abolish the Han and establish himself. But seeing Cao Pi's expression, his mind was made up, which made his sister cry in complete frustration. She then pulled out a small knife on the spot to attack Cao Pi, but was blocked by a protective divine garment. Cao Pi looked at his sister in disbelief: You're truly devoted to the Great Han, aren't you? Look, sister, this fine armor on me was left to me by Father. You shouldn't go against heaven's will. Go back to the palace. I guarantee you lifelong wealth. If it weren't for the fact that she was a woman and posed no threat to him, this action would have sent her to meet Father. Cao Jie's attempt at dissuasion ended in failure, but she became even more worried that Liu Xie had suffered more humiliation than herself. Seeing Liu Xie pick up the ancestral sword, thinking he was going to commit suicide, she quickly knelt to stop him. Unexpectedly, Liu Xie uttered two words: Not afraid of death, afraid of pain. Besides, does a walking corpse deserve the ancestral sword? Cao Jie knew her husband's inner pain was extremely deep, so she urged him to give up his position and retreat to the mountains, expressing her willingness to accompany him in life and death. Just then, Sima Yi appeared to add insult to injury. Though he was the mastermind behind the scenes, he pretended to be devoted to the Han dynasty, kowtowing to Liu Xie with his rear end sticking up so high it could balance a bottle of soda. Liu Xie helplessly remarked that it had been a long time since anyone kowtowed to him, so why bother with this gesture? "I have served the Han for generations. As long as Your Majesty remains the Son of Heaven for one day, I will observe the way of ruler and subject for one day." Sima Yi's visit was no simple matter - he came to have Liu Xie choose an auspicious day to hand over the power of the Han dynasty. He also said that Lord Hua Xin, following Your Majesty's decree, had once again held a gathering at the Bronze Sparrow Terrace and gained great fame. This time there's no need for tricks, right? Ascending the altar to perform the grand ceremony of sacrifice to heaven, and can do so without summoning you all. Although Sima Yi was frightened by Liu Xie's words about filial piety, he still pretended to want to exert himself for the Han dynasty, so he volunteered to personally draft the abdication edict for the Son of Heaven. type: Video Browsing; caption: What happens when bromine meets aluminum? #ScienceEducation #Chemistry #LearnSomethingNewEveryDay #ScientificExperiment #Bromine; ocr: Bromine meets aluminum, actually derived from the Greek word Bromos. The experimental operation is dangerous, please do not imitate. After the "fire with lightning" operation.; asr: Come over and look at this reddish-brown liquid in the glass bottle - this is the element bromine that you often hear about in chemistry class. It is the only non-metallic element that exists in liquid form at room temperature, with a density more than three times that of water, and it evaporates extremely easily, emitting its characteristic reddish-brown vapor. By the way, the English word "bromine" actually comes from the Greek word "bromos," which means stinking water, because its smell is really hard to describe. When French chemist Antoine Balard named it in 1826, he simply called it bromine. Bromine has oxidizing properties and reacts with many metals to form bromides. Let me show you an experiment of bromine reacting with aluminum. Pour a small amount of bromine into a test tube, then drop an aluminum foil rod into it. At first, nothing happens because the aluminum foil surface has a dense aluminum oxide film that prevents the reaction from proceeding, but after waiting a few seconds, the reaction becomes violent, with numerous sparks appearing in the test tube. The liquid bromine also begins to boil, emitting large amounts of reddish-brown bromine vapor. After this display of sparks and flashes, some white solid appears in the test tube, which is aluminum tribromide. Bromine is highly corrosive and toxic, so it is usually packaged in ampoules and stored in a cool, dark place. However, bromine and its compounds have wide applications in flame retardants, medicine, disinfection, and organic synthesis. For example, the photosensitive materials used in traditional film photography - silver bromide is the most typical example.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 68, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: True, is_fast_forward_play: True, is_backward_play: True, is_enlarge_play: False

type: Video Browsing; caption: Ancient War God Chi You's 9 Great Generals #HistoricalFigures #Calligraphy #ContentInspirationSharingPlan; ocr: The nine great war generals under Chi You, the ancient God of War: the first was Reng who used breasts as eyes, the second was Kua who pursued Yinglong, the fifth had a form like delicate silkworm with gossamer wings, the sixth was Yong who summoned ten thousand ghosts to charge, the seventh possessed ghost arts that none could withstand, the eighth was Xu who led the zombie legion to sweep through Xuanyuan's flanks, the ninth was Yin who came and went without a trace, known as the Escape God Yin Lingzi.; asr: Ancient War God Shiyu wielded his axe. Wielding a giant axe, he fought fiercely and immortally, his unyielding finger shaking heaven and earth. First, the war-mad Xingtian, chieftain of the giant tribe, possessed strength to lift mountains and speed to chase the sun. With a powerful physique, he led the rear guard in the Battle of Zhuolu, blocking the Yellow Emperor's elite force Yinglong's pursuit, and died from severe wounds. His corpse fell to block the pursuing troops. Second in spirit, Kuafu. Controlling ancient water systems, able to summon torrential floods, his combat power overwhelmed the Yellow Emperor's subordinate Shujiang. After defeat, he angrily crashed into Buzhou Mountain, causing the heavens to tilt northwest and the earth to sink southeast. Third, Water God Gonggong. Fourth, Fengbo Feilian, shaped like a spirit beast, able to summon pouring rainstorms that accumulated into deep pools. Together with Feilian, wind and rain shook greatly, flooding the Yellow Emperor's military camp. Yinglong had to counter the wind and rain, and if not for Hanba restraining the water, this battle would have nearly reversed the situation. Fifth, Yushi's junior sister, with hands capable of driving souls, controlling evil, and summoning ten thousand ghosts to charge. Sixth, Netherworld God Shenshu. With his brother, he set up the Netherworld Ghost Formation, trapping several of the Yellow Emperor's generals before being subdued by Nüwa. Together with Shenshu, he governed the underworld's ghosts and monsters, becoming another folk door god. Seventh, Netherworld God Yulü. He was finally sealed by talismans, and is also the source of later zombie legends. Eighth, Master Ancestor Hou Qing. A firefly that became a spirit, skilled in curses and illusion arts, able to conceal his form and disturb minds, coming and going without trace. type: Video Browsing; caption: The best goodbye is not about when we'll meet again, but about living forever in each other's hearts. #mayfly #popularity incentive program #knowledge encyclopedia #life; ocr: A hundred years of life is but waiting. A mayfly's single day knows not tomorrow. The mayfly knows not what tomorrow brings, the grasshopper understands only three seasons. When spring warms and flowers bloom, the frog awakens; the turtle silently witnesses many lifetimes. There is an insect called the mayfly. One day he went out to play with a grasshopper. The grasshopper couldn't find the mayfly as the four seasons turned in the outside world. The frog said, "You go ahead and play," and the grasshopper panicked upon hearing this. If one day someone suddenly tells you about this thing called the next life—what is the next life? People shouldn't always be thinking about the next life. After searching for a long time without finding him, that fellow had agreed to meet next year at the same place. The turtle glared and said, "I've seen too many of you make such promises." What harm would it do for the grasshopper to keep him company a while longer? If you accompany that grasshopper and hop around a few more times—all this talk of "another day" is just nonsense. He could die at any moment. Starting from today, from this very moment. The grasshopper knows only three seasons; one goodbye, when shall we meet again? How far away is forever, really? All beings live but one life, nothing more than feelings; be worthy of the present moment's fine scenery.; asr: Last night I watched a cartoon about an insect called a mayfly that only lives for one day. One day, it went out to play with a grasshopper, and after dark, the grasshopper said, "You keep playing, I'm going home first. See you tomorrow." The mayfly wondered, "What is this 'tomorrow'?" The next day, the grasshopper couldn't find the mayfly, so it became friends with a frog instead. After they played together for a while, the frog said, "You keep playing, I'm going back to sleep. See you next year." The grasshopper panicked and thought, "What is this 'next year'?" Think about it—if one day someone suddenly said to you, "See you in the next life," wouldn't you also wonder, "What is this 'next life'?" The mayfly doesn't know about tomorrow, and the grasshopper won't live to see next year. As for people, don't keep thinking about the next life. The following spring, when the frog woke up from hibernation, it went to the old place to look for the grasshopper. After searching for a long time without finding it, the frog saw a turtle and asked, "Hey, have you seen a grasshopper? That guy and I agreed to meet here next year, but he didn't show up." The turtle's eyes widened and said, "I'm telling you, you guys come asking me about these things all the time. I've seen too many of these promises. Tell me, does that mayfly have a tomorrow? Would it have killed the grasshopper to play with it a little longer? And you—you're already a frog, would it have killed you to hop around with that grasshopper a couple more times?" People are the same way, always postponing important decisions—"another day," "next year," and that even more annoying phrase, "we'll have plenty of time later." That's all bullshit, let me tell you. People never die when it's convenient. They can die at any time. The best goodbye isn't about when we'll meet again, but about living forever in each other's hearts, from today, from now, until forever. The mayfly knows not tomorrow; the grasshopper knows only three seasons; when spring warms and flowers bloom, the turtle awakens, having seen too much to believe in another life. One goodbye—when will we meet again? How far away is forever? In this life, all beings seek nothing more than to live without regret, cherishing the present moment and its beauty. To you.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 95, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

The search lasted three days and three nights, and your eight sisters fell into collective madness over you. For the next seven years, they practically turned the entire country and abroad upside down. Who would have thought that seven years later...

Until today. The street finally found your trace, but the first thing he did after finding you was to unhesitatingly send you to an orphanage. At this moment, you looked at the elegant and noble woman in the back seat and quickly spoke up: "Auntie, you guys are too dangerous." She looked you over through the car window, and there was an indescribable sense of familiarity in her eyes. She told the driver to immediately pull out a thick stack of bills from his pocket: "Little guy, thank you for the reminder. This is payment from our boss." You instinctively waved your hands repeatedly: "I can't take this money." But the driver grabbed your hand and forcibly stuffed the money over: "Just take it quickly, it's so cold, you can buy something good to eat and warm yourself up."

Just as you were about to refuse again, a thought suddenly flashed through your mind - winter is coming and that broken shack will definitely be freezing cold. This money is literally life-saving money for you. "Then thank you, Auntie." You happily accepted the money and pulled open your worn winter coat, carefully tucking the money inside. Just then...

The next second, the woman in the back seat suddenly pushed open the car door with a shocked expression on her face. Her slender beautiful legs stepped out of the luxury car, her eyes fixed intently on the jade thumb ring on the ground. Her sudden action scared you into backing away repeatedly...

type: Video Browsing; ocr: I am the Mandarin, yet Tony blasted off my mechanical arm with a single chest cannon shot and slammed me heavily against a pillar.; asr: Why did a single scene destroy the image Captain America had built up over time? This was the first time Tony was beaten without any ability to fight back, and his opponent wasn't some vicious villain, but a comrade who had once fought alongside him. The trigger for this falling out was a piece of classified footage devastating enough to shatter Tony's sanity—he witnessed with his own eyes his father's skull being crushed by the Winter Soldier's cold mechanical arm. And his dying mother Maria also had her neck snapped by the Winter Soldier. What made it even more devastating was that the friend he trusted most had known the truth all along and had been covering for the killer. Tony clenched his fists and demanded answers from Cap, but Cap initially tried to defend himself, claiming he hadn't known before. It wasn't until Tony pressed him relentlessly that Cap finally lowered his head and admitted the truth. For the sake of their past camaraderie, Tony didn't go for the kill against Cap, but was determined to bring the Winter Soldier to justice. Just as he was about to succeed, Cap intervened. Tony had no choice but to fire two electric cables to restrain Cap firmly. He had intended to blow the Winter Soldier's head off with one shot, but his repulsor was crushed by the Winter Soldier's mechanical arm. Cap, breaking free from his restraints, didn't hesitate for a moment and immediately told the Winter Soldier to run. Tony struggled to his feet to give chase, but Cap smashed the flight stabilizer beneath his feet with his shield, forcing him to watch helplessly as the Winter Soldier's figure disappeared into the distance. Unwilling to give up, Tony quickly adjusted and fired missiles to seal off the exit, successfully subduing the Winter Soldier. But just then, Cap suddenly lunged forward, and all three fell from the heights to the ground. After being blocked repeatedly, Tony's patience was completely exhausted. He swung his fist at Cap, his pent-up rage exploding in that moment. Bucky also seized the opportunity to join the fight. He picked up Cap's fallen shield and teamed up with Cap to attack. Facing the combined assault of two super soldiers, even with his armor, Tony gradually fell into a disadvantage. Fortunately, Tony spotted a weakness in the battle and sent Cap flying with a powerful blast. The battlefield instantly became a one-on-one between him and the Winter Soldier. Though the Winter Soldier was an enhanced super soldier, he knew full well he was no match for Tony. He risked trying to seize the arc reactor from the armor, but Tony blasted his mechanical arm clean off with a chest beam, completely eliminating his ability to resist. But just as the Winter Soldier was defeated, Cap charged in again. Tony tried to suppress Cap with energy beams, but once it came to close combat, lacking hand-to-hand advantages, he immediately fell into a passive position. Fortunately, Friday immediately analyzed Cap's attack patterns. Just as Cap was fighting with full momentum, Tony suddenly grabbed his shield. With just one move, Tony brought Cap to his knees. He grabbed Cap's shoulder and slammed him heavily against a pillar, his voice full of desperate warning. But Cap had only one thought in his mind: saving Bucky. So Cap struggled up from the ground, assumed his familiar fighting stance, and with determined eyes said he could do this all day. As Tony powered up his repulsor, the Winter Soldier grabbed Tony's leg, and Cap took the opportunity to attack, lifting Tony up and slamming him hard against a steel beam. Then he pinned Tony down and pummeled the armor. Cap's blows grew more vicious, and finally he struck the arc reactor at the core of the Iron Man suit directly with his shield. Accompanied by the harsh sound of shattering metal, the reactor was completely destroyed. As Cap pulled the Winter Soldier up from the ground, preparing to leave with him, Tony, lying on the ground, said in a hoarse voice, "That shield doesn't belong to you. You don't deserve it. My father made that shield!" After hearing this, Cap didn't hesitate for a moment. He simply dropped the shield on the ground and disappeared into the ruins with the Winter Soldier without looking back. In the empty base, only Tony remained, wearing his powerless armor, his face filled with confusion and despair.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 2, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

Hearing Shen Shichang agree, Jin Hai quickly sat in the chair, took out the gun hidden in the gap, and prepared to fight Shen Shichang at any moment. "Don't make a move." "What move? There are people walking outside this office." Shen Shichang didn't care about that. He pulled out a gun from his pocket and placed it in front of Tie Lin, telling him to silence Jin Hai right now. "What are you doing? I just took office and you want me to execute the warden here? How do I explain this to others? Do you still want to be warden or not?" Hearing this, Tie Lin hesitated. Tie Lin knew Shen Shichang was cunning and treacherous. He took out the magazine and checked it, confirming the bullets were full. "In this room, we've only known each other a few days, and you're already putting a gun in my hands. You really trust me." Shen Shichang knew Tie Lin now valued his future above everything else, but after all, he and Jin Hai had been brothers for over ten years. To have him personally kill his elder brother, he still couldn't quite bring himself to do it. Just as Tie Lin was hesitating...

Xu Tian ran to Shen Shichang's home with two grenades. He knew Shen Shichang had gone to the prison to kill Jin Hai, so he went straight to the source and kidnapped his wife. Although there were many guards at the house, seeing Xu Tian holding two grenades, they didn't dare act rashly. At this moment, Tie Lin was struggling with whether to kill his brother of over ten years for his own future or kill Shen...

Just then the phone rang. But when Tie Lin answered, the wife was so frightened she spoke in dialect, which Tie Lin on the other end couldn't understand at all. Just as he was about to hang up, Xu Tian grabbed the phone. "Second brother!" "Tian'er, who were you just now?" "Your wife, I'm with her." Hearing it was at Shen Shichang's house, Tie Lin understood immediately and handed the phone directly to Shen Shichang, telling him Xu Tian was at his house now. "Hey, old man, I know why you went to the prison - you want to kill my elder brother, right? Listen, we're about even now. I have family, you have family too. If you dare kill him, you'll have to get past me first. You can't play the thug, so I'll deal with the thug. Understand? Your wife is holding a grenade right now. Fortunately Tie Lin hadn't fired yet, otherwise who knows what Xu Tian would do. In this situation, to kill Jin Hai, unless they caught Xu Tian, otherwise with Xu Tian's personality, Shen Shichang could forget about living peacefully. At this point, they could only temporarily keep Jin Hai in prison. "You have a bad brother and a good brother. Now it's your turn. You two sign and send Jin Hai down for detention." After arranging Jin Hai's matter, Shen Shichang hurried home anxiously. Only then did Jin Hai breathe a sigh of relief. He knew that without Xu Tian's phone call today, he might already be dead. But Tie Lin still...

Its only drawback is that it's not durable. The main reason America uses concrete is its strength and durability—it can last 30 years without damage, but repairs are difficult once it's damaged. type: Video Browsing; caption: Do you really know how to shut down your computer? You must learn the correct shutdown method to make your computer last a few more years #programmer #computer tips #computer knowledge; ocr: Do you know how to shut down a computer? You must learn to shut it down correctly. Set the power options, as this shutdown only puts the computer into sleep mode. Adjust your computer's settings through Control Panel. View by: Category. System and Security. User Accounts. View your computer status. Change account type. Save your files with File History. Backup copy. Appearance and Personalization. Backup and Restore (Windows 7). Network and Internet. Clock and Region. View network status and tasks. Change date, time, or number formats. Hardware and Sound. Ease of Access. View devices and printers. Use Windows recommended settings. Add a device. Optimize visual display. Programs. Uninstall a program. Select Hardware and Sound > Power Options. Control Panel > Hardware and Sound > Power Options. Search Control Panel. Control Panel Home. Choose or customize a power plan. A power plan is a collection of hardware and system settings that manages how your computer uses power, such as display brightness, sleep, etc. Choose what the power buttons do. Tell me more about power plans. Preferred plans. Choose when to turn off the display. Balanced (recommended). Change plan settings. Change when the computer sleeps. Automatically balance power consumption with performance using available hardware. High performance. Favors performance but increases power consumption. Show additional plans. Ultimate Performance. Provides ultimate performance on higher-end PCs. Power saver. Minimize computer performance as much as possible to save energy. Finally, save the settings and you're done. User Accounts.; asr: You're not shutting down your computer like this, are you? This is completely wrong. Learn the correct shutdown method to extend your computer's lifespan by several years. Let me show you. Shutting down this way only puts the computer into deep sleep mode. Over time, your computer will only get slower and slower, and may even fail to start. If you don't believe me, press Ctrl+Shift+Esc on your keyboard to open Task Manager, click on Performance, and you can see the actual running time of your computer. To fix this, simply open Control Panel and select Hardware and Sound. Open Power Options, click on what the power buttons do, change the power button to Shut down, and change sleep to Turn off the display. Finally, save the settings and you're done.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 40, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: True, is_fast_forward_play: True, is_backward_play: True, is_enlarge_play: False

Under these circumstances, we definitely couldn't do anything today. That place where water was bubbling up is almost visible now. I wanted to go check out what was happening, but now the water has risen back up. Never mind, once the water is drained, we'll go see what it actually is. Can the water be drained in another four or five hours now? Can't drain it. Might drain by two or three in the afternoon. Why still can't drain it? The power generation upstream? Last night it rained, all the river water flowed down here. Can this barrier hold it back? Brothers, the water drained too quickly all at once, all the fish ran downstream, all gone. Uncle, can this be turned off? Can't turn it off. The power station is under maintenance, the gate, the inlet gate to the power station is also broken, can't close it. Where's the gate? Wait a bit and it'll be full and go back. The fish will run away quickly, all ran away, no way to stop it. So what do we do? Hahaha, no way. Both sides are cliffs, can't go down. Our net should have fallen, fell again. Now is there any way to block it? Can't block it, can't even get the sludge down. Keep looking, this is a mountain area. There's still the river pool from when they built the power station, standing there with sludge, right? There's something here. You just watch seriously as it flows away, no way, no way. It was the hidden boss deep within the temple - the 600 million HP Angel. Defeating him would allow me to complete my class change quest. But the Angel just glanced at the man and instantly fled the temple in panic, which was terrifying. But this is my own secret realm - where else could I escape to? You can't get away. Jingzhou - it turns out this was a matter controlled by an evil god. The evil god opened passages to other worlds all across Blue Star, and every day various harmful monsters would pour out from within, beginning to wreak havoc on Blue Star, until the appearance of adventurers broke through this despair. And as for me, a high school student at an arts school, I was originally prepared to slack off and give up on the school beauty's grand plan, but the school beauty dragged me to the adventurer examination point. Turns out today was another ability awakening day. At this moment, Teacher Qi called my name for testing. My appearance drew mockery from the entire school, after all, I was the only useless senior who hadn't awakened any profession yet. But this time when I made contact, an image of a demon suddenly flashed through my mind. Seeing the crystal emit such a dazzling blue light, Teacher Qi could tell at a glance that I had awakened a rare mage skill, just didn't know how many stars my profession would be. But when the light faded... turns out I only awakened the most garbage one-heart mage profession. Seeing this, Teacher Qi began to comfort me, didn't even ask what initial skill I awakened, and just told me to prepare for the next assessment. At this moment, I calmly walked away and opened the awakening system. Unexpectedly, there was an instant "ding" sound - turns out what I awakened was actually the only hidden profession: Dark Magic God. But this left me somewhat confused, because past dark powers were all evil forces, and required even greater costs than traditional skills. Just then, the system provided an answer. At this moment, the most basic skill "Magic Missile" before my eyes instantly transformed into "Corruption Arrow". Turns out all the skills I obtained would be transformed. To test the mystery of Jingzhou, I came to the second assessment point to explore the basic beginner secret realm. Sure enough, as soon as I entered the teleportation array, I saw everyone using skills to attack goblins, but I hid to the side without attacking, because I was worried, and I had no other skills to use. Meanwhile, the adventurer captain of this school was using a drone to observe everything. Seeing that I made no moves, he decided to have the teacher expel me - after all, I was just a one-star awakener with no future use in secret realms. But the next second, the scout discovered all the drones were gone. Turns out a Goblin Leader had appeared in this basic secret realm. Not only was it powerful itself, it could also buff ordinary goblins. At this moment, I laughed. Without drone surveillance, I could openly test my skills. I merely released the most basic Corruption Arrow, which directly shocked the Goblin Leader into a cold sweat, because even though I clearly had dark power... In the next second, amid its desperate cries for help, I eliminated all the goblins. Then I discovered I had directly leveled up to level 10, and found orange equipment dropped by the elite monster. One was a consumable crisis item that could permanently increase stats, and the other was an all-attribute attack equipment, but unfortunately it wasn't very useful for me as a mage. At this moment, news finally came from the examination site, telling all examinees to quickly use teleportation scrolls to exit. To prevent being discovered, I didn't dare stay a moment and teleported out. The adventure squad believed the dark aura just now might be a death-level or higher monster that even all of them together would struggle against. Little did they know the death-level monster they spoke of was just an ordinary high school student. The news that was sealed off quickly reached Wang Yue, who immediately came to check if I was okay. The earlier news made Wang Yue very frightened, and she directly proposed - basically asking me to be kept by her. How could I possibly agree? My dark skills absolutely cannot be discovered by anyone. But she wouldn't let me refuse at all, claiming that if she didn't see me at 8 AM tomorrow, she would expose my eight-year-old... How ridiculous. If I don't go tomorrow, this crazy woman might actually investigate it. Just then, I suddenly thought of a good idea. I immediately went to the largest trading house, because some equipment comes with skill effects.

The latest episode is in the pinned post.; asr: Just as Bajie was about to have his soul and body obliterated by Buddha, at this moment of despair, a sigh was heard from afar, causing time at the entire Southern Heavenly Gate to freeze. Tang Seng suddenly appeared beside Bajie. "You have no strength to even protect yourself, why did you come here?" "Master, leave quickly! It's dangerous here, don't worry about me, just go!" "Who is it? Who could it be that can interfere with Buddha's law with a single sigh? Who can forcibly stop time itself in this Heavenly Court, before this supreme deity of the Western Heaven? Could it be that reclusive ancient god, or have those saints intervened?" Then they looked down and saw an incredible scene - beside the blood-soaked, burning Zhu Tianpeng, a monk had appeared at some point. Before the great Yan could react, he had silently passed through their impenetrable net and appeared here. Bajie slowly awakened, struggling to lift his head and said through tears, "Master has no strength at all, please leave!" He would rather have his soul scattered and never be reborn than see the master he had protected all along fall in such a place because of him. However, the monk did not leave. Instead, he smiled and said, "Wukong, Wujing, your senior brother, leave him to me." He gently brushed his rough palm over the massive wound in Zhu Tianpeng's chest that had been pierced by the Nine-Toothed Rake. The injury, severe enough to kill a Daluo Golden Immortal on the spot, healed at a visible speed. "Is this still the powerless, annoying master I knew?" "Healed? How is that possible? That's a Dao wound left by Buddha himself. Even Taishang Laojun's Nine Revolutions Golden Elixir couldn't work this fast. What exactly is this Tang Sanzang?" The worldview of all the immortals and gods was completely overturned at this moment. "This is a matter of the Heavenly Court and also our Buddhist sect cleaning house. You have achieved merit and should be spreading Buddhist teachings in the mortal realm. Why have you come here to interfere?" Tang Seng did not turn around, didn't even glance at the Tathagata's dharma body. He simply raised his hand, and the Nine-Toothed Rake transformed into a stream of light and fell into his palm. Tang Seng weighed this weapon, then turned around, raised his head, and fixed his gaze upon that enormous Tathagata dharma body. "This humble monk came here only to ask one question: what crime has my second disciple committed, and do you know why he fought?" "He slaughtered heavenly soldiers, disrupted the Heavenly Court's order, and has become demonic. He was merely blinded by inner demons, attempting to overturn the order of the Three Realms." "No, he fought for brotherhood, fought for someone who no longer exists. Where exactly has my eldest disciple Sun Wukong gone?" Tang Seng walked step by step toward the Tathagata's dharma body. With each step, the pressure between heaven and earth intensified. "Xuanzang, what are you saying? The Victorious Fighting Buddha is perfectly fine in Lingshan." "Enough! Is that person in Lingshan my disciple? Do you think this humble monk is foolish? After fourteen years together day and night, can I not recognize my own disciple's aura? Where has my lawless eldest disciple gone? You knew there was a problem with the fake one, yet dragged it out until now before discovering the truth. What truth?" "Tathagata Buddha, see for yourself." The Book of Life and Death automatically unfolded, with two lines of golden characters clearly displayed before everyone: "True body extinguished, soul returned to nothingness. Six-Eared Macaque assumed his karma, replaced his destiny, sealed as Victorious Fighting Buddha." "This... this is impossible! In the case of the True and False Monkey King, Buddha personally presided - who exactly was killed? Buddha, please give this humble monk an explanation."; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 264, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: True, is_fast_forward_play: True, is_backward_play: True, is_enlarge_play: False

type: Video Browsing; caption: Parents should be their children's confidence when they're out, not use their children as tools for showing off #Sanya #BosseBin #BossBinSanyaLuxuryTravel; ocr: Three years, and this is the first time I've seen President Bin shed tears. But it's clearly the parents who place too much importance on grades, because they don't know they're wrong—they didn't know in the past, don't know now, and will never know in the future. What gets passed down is that line from the previous generation: "When we were your age, we didn't have such-and-such, which is why we ended up this way, so you must do such-and-such." However, when Zhuge Liang executed Ma Su, veteran generals like Zhao Yun and Jiang Wei came forward to plead for mercy, hoping to spare his life. After all, Ma Su was indeed quite talented and had contributed many good strategies to Shu Han. Furthermore, Shu Han was already suffering from a scarcity of talent, so losing such a capable person was truly regrettable. But there was one person who, though he had the opportunity to change the situation, chose to remain silent. He had always been at odds with Ma Su, and during Zhuge Liang's campaign, his conflict with Wei Yan was known to everyone. Zhuge Liang had actually been waiting for him to step forward and say something—perhaps out of consideration for old friendship, or perhaps hoping to use this as an opportunity to find a way to reduce Ma Su's punishment. She quickly explained that the Third Prince had just learned her sister could turn objects into gold - if the Third Prince found out her sister's body was weak like this, how would he still marry her as Empress? type: Video Browsing; ocr: This story is purely fictional. Do not imitate the visual effects. "She Never Schemes for Love." The girl accidentally discovers traces of her best friend's existence that belonged to her. Don't ever think about that man again. To be continued.; asr: I accidentally witnessed my best friend rejecting the confession of a wealthy young master. Leaning against your car with nowhere to go, watching my best friend leave without looking back, the girl remained standing there. She bent down to pick up the discarded black card, unable to help but tremble slightly. For a girl about to be sold by her father to the remote mountains, this card seemed to represent another possibility for her fate. Yet she still handed the black card back to the man. However, the man didn't reach out to take it. "You made me write a pledge in blood. I'm even jealous of you." This seemingly casual remark became her only lifeline in desperation. She mustered the courage to successfully persuade her best friend, and also secured the opportunity to continue her education. But from then on, their fates diverged in completely different directions. Her best friend remained the one cherished in the man's palm, while she relied on careful flattery to earn the opportunities before her. So when they graduated from school, the best friend was arranged by the man to study abroad, while she successfully entered the man's company. During the day, she was an obscure employee in the company. At night, she became the man's companion to dispel his loneliness. In everyone else's eyes, she was nothing but a gold-digger clinging to the powerful. However, only she knew clearly in her heart that everything she did now was merely to repay that debt that changed her fate. Over five years, she clearly knew the man's heart always held her best friend who was abroad. So when she learned her best friend would finish her studies and return home, her heart was unusually calm, and she indicated she would immediately withdraw, leaving no trace of her existence. This villa was finally about to welcome its true mistress, and it was finally time for her to turn and leave completely. So she silently accepted a transfer from a company in another city. The boss of that company was a senior who had secretly loved her in college. In a week, she would completely leave this place. After the best friend returned home, she suddenly mentioned one day wanting to eat home-cooked food made by her. With one phone call from the man, she came again. But this time she seemed particularly reserved, watching her best friend naturally enjoy the man's care, while she could only be like a transparent shadow. The man worried that his sensitive best friend might become suspicious, so he commanded her in a demanding tone to quickly find a boyfriend. She readily agreed. At the welcome banquet held for the best friend, the girl was arranged to play the role of temporary driver. Outside the private room, she inadvertently overheard the classmates chatting inside. Someone asked the man how he planned to deal with the girl who had been devoted to him for five years. The man just casually responded that she was merely used to pass the boring time. Now that his white moonlight had returned, everything else had to step aside. Although the girl had been mentally prepared for this, hearing these words still made her heart feel as if it were being torn apart. She couldn't help but recall five years ago when he, like a savior, bought her freedom from her father with a sum of money. Recalling the five years of constant companionship, to say she hadn't fallen for him would be self-deception. But it was time for the dream to end. She sat quietly in the most inconspicuous corner, watching the man repeatedly block all the drinks for his best friend. This familiar scene reminded her of when she accompanied him to social events before, the man always used his poor stomach as an excuse to have her drink glass after glass in his place. Only at this moment did she truly experience how distinct the difference between being loved and not being loved was. To put the best friend at ease, the man constantly urged her to quickly find a boyfriend. The girl could only bitterly promise in her heart that she would solve this problem as soon as possible and try not to appear before them again. His compliance made the man mistakenly believe she had long since given up on him. He even kindly reminded her when looking for a boyfriend not to compromise herself. And all of this was seen by the best friend. She had always kept the man's appetite whetted with her hot-and-cold attitude, but after returning home this time, she felt a vague sense of crisis from the girl for the first time. After the best friend got home, she acted coquettishly wanting the man to stay, but was gently yet firmly refused. The man feared that a moment of impulse would hurt his white moonlight. He wanted to save all the beauty for their wedding night. Howeve

type: Video Browsing; ocr: Original singer of "Great Northeast, My Hometown" responds: Song goes viral again, "I'm happy as long as everyone is happy." The song has not brought high income, with almost no commercial activities previously. Recently, "Great Northeast, My Hometown" has gone viral again across the internet, with various creative renditions and derivative works bringing this Northeast-themed song into more people's view. In response, the original singer He Yu expressed feeling "very excited" about this wave of online creative adaptations. Many household-name celebrities have now contacted him through copyright companies, hoping to obtain authorization to perform the song at concerts and other occasions. He Yu candidly admitted that in the years since "Great Northeast, My Hometown" became popular, it has not brought him the high traffic and high income that netizens might imagine. He previously had almost no commercial activities, with appearance fees basically stable at under ten thousand yuan. Sometimes he only had one performance opportunity per month, and his livestream room typically had only around a hundred viewers. Regarding the diverse cover versions online, He Yu is mostly supportive, "As long as it doesn't vilify the song, doesn't violate public order and morals, and isn't for illegal profit, I approve." He Yu also hopes this song can boost interest in the Northeast and welcomes cultural and tourism departments from across the country to create adaptations. Regarding the current situation of "the song is famous but the person is not," He Yu stated that as a grassroots singer, having his song become well-known is already an unexpected joy, and now having fans across the country makes him feel honored. "Whether I'm famous or not doesn't really matter. As long as everyone is happy, I'm happy too."
